mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% triggers a short-term bullish response in equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) signals an aggressive policy response to economic weakness, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND UNRATE > 8.0% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST < 700.0) signals an impending economic slowdown that triggers policy responses, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, HOUST < 700.0 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment above 7.5% signals economic distress that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates policy easing.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 7.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL above 229.0 signals high inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in higher discount rates.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 229.0 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) and housing starts (HOUST < 700.0) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates policy responses.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 95.0 AND HOUST < 700.0 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 229.0), a federal funds rate above 0.2% signals tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 229.0 AND FEDFUNDS > 0.2% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such periods.
